04.scope: Arizona residents with abortions reported in Arizona, Table 14.

occurrence.scope: Reported abortions to Arizona residents by Arizona county where the procedure occurred, Table 5D-3. The source excludes nonresidents and does not give separate counts for unlisted counties.

12.scope: Florida reports by patient county of residence. The agency suppresses county counts of 20 or fewer.

occurrence.scope: Induced terminations reported in Florida by county where the procedure occurred, Table T-1. The source reports zeros explicitly.

15.scope: Reported abortions among Hawaiʻi residents. The source publishes data for four counties and excludes records with unknown county.

17.scope: Illinois residents with terminations reported in Illinois. The archive suppresses counts of 50 or fewer. From 2015, the Cook County figure sums the Chicago and suburban Cook reporting areas.

20.scope: Kansas resident abortions reported to the state, Table D9(A). Out-of-state reporting may lack county of residence.

26.scope: Michigan residents with induced abortions reported in Michigan, Table H-1.

occurrence.scope: Induced abortions reported in Michigan in 2023, grouped by county of the facility. Michigan DHHS, Table 29. The table lists 13 counties.

27.scope: Minnesota residents with induced abortions reported in Minnesota, Table 7. The agency suppresses county counts of 0 to 5. The report includes revised 2023 data.

31.scope: Nebraska residents with abortions reported in Nebraska. The state publishes county figures only where it recorded at least six cases.

occurrence.scope: Reported abortions performed in Nebraska by county of occurrence. The reports publish three named counties and aggregate or omit any other county figures.

39.scope: Ohio residents with induced abortions reported in Ohio, Table 5. In 2020 and 2021 the published county sums differ by one from the state total after excluding unknown residence.

occurrence.scope: Induced abortions reported to the Ohio Department of Health, by county of occurrence, Table 2. The table publishes 22 named counties. Counts with no county reported are excluded, including telehealth prescriptions to Ohio residents. County totals differ from the report's statewide headline by two in 2016 and 2017.

41.scope: Oregon residents with abortions reported in Oregon. These are the final annual totals from the state's workbook. The published 2018 rows sum to one fewer than the worksheet total.

45.scope: Reported abortions among South Carolina residents by county of residence, Table E-2. The report lists 6,646 additional abortions with unknown county of residence in 2024.

occurrence.scope: Reported abortions in South Carolina by county of occurrence, including patients who lived elsewhere. Vital and Morbidity Statistics, Table 48 (2000) and Table E-3 (2001–2014). The reports explain that counties omitted from the occurrence table had no occurrences.

53.scope: Washington resident abortions in the state vital statistics reports, Table 15. The totals include reported procedures obtained out of state.

occurrence.scope: Reported procedures within Washington, Table 26a occurrence totals. The tracker shows counties with separately published totals. The source combines other counties.

36.scope: Reported induced terminations by borough of residence in New York City health department records. Coverage is limited to the city's five boroughs, which are equivalent to five New York counties. The city report excludes procedures outside New York City.

37.scope: Reports by county of patient residence in North Carolina. Dashes and blanks in the early source tables have no numeric counts. North Carolina reports that abortion forms were underreported from 2011 to 2014.

occurrence.scope: Reports by county of procedure in North Carolina. Dashes and blanks in the 2000 to 2004 tables have no numeric counts. The 2001 state headline equals the named county total, with 785 additional reports printed under unknown county. North Carolina reports that abortion forms were underreported from 2011 to 2014.

42.scope: Reported induced abortions among Pennsylvania residents by county of residence, Table D-6. Reports with an unknown county are excluded from the county figures. The published county sums fall short of the statewide totals by one in 1995 and four in 2006.

occurrence.scope: Induced abortions reported in Pennsylvania, grouped by county where the procedure occurred, including patients who lived outside Pennsylvania. Pennsylvania Vital Statistics, Table D-7.

18.scope: Indiana Department of Health, Table 14, total induced terminations among Indiana residents by county of residence. Unknown counties are excluded and source suppression is preserved.

51.scope: Virginia Department of Health annual resident counts by county and independent city. Unknown residence is excluded. Former independent cities remain in historical tables. In 2002 the published locality counts sum to one fewer than the statewide total.

55.scope: Wisconsin residents with induced abortions reported in Wisconsin. Annual county totals from Tables 18 and 19. Source suppression is preserved. Wisconsin DHS notes interrupted in-state provision in 2022 and 2023. The figures do not measure all abortions obtained out of state.
